titleScreen.flavor:
The dead don't stay dead.
Unfortunately, you're on the clock.
titleScreen.howto: Ghosts in the other world are dim. Cross through them to banish.
titleScreen.howtoTouch: Double-tap right on a dim ghost to dash at it.
titleScreen.howtoEnd: Chain banishes to refill your lantern. Survive until midnight.

tips.intro:
Your shift begins at nine.
Please return the deceased to their graves.
tips.crossKb:
Dim ghosts are in the other world.
Face them and press SPACE to cross through.
tips.crossTc:
Dim ghosts are in the other world.
Face them (or aim at one) and double-tap to cross through.
tips.wisp:
"Should the deceased become restless, a gentle reminder
of their condition is usually sufficient."
